title.tr: Gazete üzerinde yeni cilalanmış turuncu-kahve kasa
title.en: Freshly varnished orange-brown box on newspaper

alt.tr: Dükkân önünde gazete serili zeminde duran, yeni vernik sürülmüş turuncu-kahve yatay tahtalı ahşap çiçeklik
alt.en: Orange-brown timber planter with horizontal boards and fresh varnish standing on newspaper in front of a shop

caption.tr: Kasanın tahtaları yatay ve vernik taze. Altına takoz konmuş, zemin vernik damlamasına karşı örtülmüş.
caption.en: The boards of the box are horizontal and the varnish is fresh. Blocks are placed under it and the floor is covered against drips.
